work.author: Meir Leibush ben Yehiel Michel Wisser (Malbim)
work.description: Malbim's nineteenth-century commentary on the Pentateuch, built on the premise that biblical Hebrew has no true synonyms and that every apparent repetition carries a distinct sense. He engages contemporary science and philosophy directly. A locus is BookToken.chapter.verse.
work.title: Ha-Torah ve-ha-Mitzvah
